title: Staffing channel catalog
description: Top-level catalog of channels. This schema defines shape only; it encodes no fee, price, capacity, or policy values and no selection, ranking, probability, or pricing decisions.

isoDate.description: ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD with month and day ranges enforced).

feeEntry.description: One dated monthly-fee entry. Value is numeric nonnegative USD or the literal string "unknown". No values are defined here.

effective_from.description: ISO date from which this fee entry is effective.

value.description: Monthly fee in USD as a nonnegative number, or the literal "unknown".

channel_id.description: Stable string identifier for this channel.

fee_usd_month.description: Dated monthly fee information. Each entry has an effective_from date and a value (nonnegative number or "unknown"). Entries must not overlap in effect via ordering conventions outside this schema; shape only is defined here.

windows.description: Rate-limit windows applicable to this channel. Window ids are drawn only from the four contract ids.

harness_lock.description: Harness identifiers this channel is locked to. May be empty; entries are unique nonempty strings.

replacement_price_ref.description: Nonempty reference (catalog pointer) to the replacement price data. A reference string only; never a price value.

instances.description: Optional independently addressable channel instances. uniqueItems enforces whole-object uniqueness; duplicate instance_id values are additionally rejected by the loader because this shape-only schema has no cross-item key constraint.

instance_id.description: Stable identifier for this channel instance.

credential_ref.description: Nonempty reference to credential storage; never a literal secret.
